mappings.control_strategy: Provide the same three preregistered A03 adversarial references with an implicit instruction to preserve identity, outfit, and pose, without assigning which reference controls which role.
mappings.variant_strategy: Replace only the opening reference instruction with explicit identity-only, outfit-only, and pose-only role declarations plus a prohibition on unrelated cross-role transfer.
mappings.single_factor_guard: Within EXP-018, reference images, ordering, A03 diagnostic conflict signatures, target studio scene, composition, and all non-role prompt text must remain identical between conditions. The A03 fixture set is the fixed experimental context, not an additional treatment factor.
fixture_requirements: Reference 1 = planned IDF-A03 v1.0.0 identity fixture; must pass preregistered acceptance criteria and be frozen with SHA-256 and dimensions before execution
Reference 2 = planned OTF-A03 v1.0.0 outfit fixture; must pass preregistered acceptance criteria and be frozen with SHA-256 and dimensions before execution
Reference 3 = planned POF-A03 v1.0.0 pose fixture; must pass preregistered acceptance criteria and be frozen with SHA-256 and dimensions before execution
reference ordering is immutable after freeze: IDF-A03, OTF-A03, POF-A03
A03 non-target traps must remain materially distinct from the registered A02 trap signatures
